name: Harbor & Hearth Kitchen
summary: Wood-fired seafood a block from the water, with a raw bar and a short, seasonal menu.
description: A sixty-seat dining room built around a wood-fired hearth. The menu follows what comes off the boats that week: whole roasted fish, clams over the coals, and a raw bar that changes daily. Reservations recommended on summer weekends.

name: Ember Street Pizza
summary: Thin, blistered pies from a deck oven, by the slice or the whole tray.
description: Family-run pizzeria with a decades-old deck oven and a dough that rests for forty-eight hours. Grandma squares on weekends, catering trays for team parties, and a counter that is busy from noon until close.

name: Morning Tide Coffee
summary: Small-batch roaster with a bright, quiet room for working mornings.
description: Coffee roasted in-house twice a week, poured as espresso, pour-over or batch brew. Laptop-friendly tables, fast Wi-Fi and pastries from local bakers. Whole beans available by the pound.

name: Pinewood Bakehouse
summary: Naturally leavened bread, laminated pastry and custom celebration cakes.
description: A scratch bakery that sells out most mornings. Sourdough loaves, croissants and seasonal fruit tarts daily, with custom cakes by order at least five days ahead.

name: Pine Barrens Plumbing Co.
summary: Licensed master plumbers for repairs, water heaters and full repipes.
description: Residential and light-commercial plumbing with upfront pricing before any work begins. Tank and tankless water heaters, sewer camera inspections, sump pumps and bathroom rough-ins.

name: Shoreline Drain & Sewer
summary: Drain clearing, hydro-jetting and trenchless sewer repair.
description: A specialist crew for the jobs other plumbers hand off: root intrusion, collapsed laterals and recurring backups. Camera footage of every line is shared with the homeowner.

name: True North Heating & Air
summary: Heat pumps, boilers and central air, installed and serviced.
description: Full-service HVAC contractor covering installs, seasonal tune-ups and maintenance plans. Heat-pump conversions and ductless mini-splits are a specialty.

name: Brightline Electric
summary: Panel upgrades, whole-home generators and EV charger installs.
description: Licensed electrical contractor for service upgrades, standby generators, EV chargers, lighting design and code corrections for home sales.

name: Route 9 Auto Care
summary: Honest independent shop for maintenance, diagnostics and brakes.
description: Six bays, ASE-certified techs and a written estimate before every repair. Domestic, Asian and European makes, with loaner cars available on longer jobs.

name: Harbor Collision Works
summary: Collision repair and refinishing, working directly with insurers.
description: Frame and unibody repair, paint matching in a downdraft booth and paintless dent removal. The front office handles the insurance paperwork end to end.

name: Atelier Barber Club
summary: Classic cuts and hot-towel shaves in a quiet, appointment-first shop.
description: Four chairs, no rush. Precision cuts, beard work and straight-razor shaves, booked by appointment with a few walk-in slots held each afternoon.

name: Salt & Silk Salon
summary: Color specialists for lived-in blondes, balayage and corrective color.
description: A color-focused salon with a free consultation before any major change. Cuts, blowouts and bridal parties by appointment.

name: Barnegat Strength Studio
summary: Small-group strength coaching capped at eight people per session.
description: Coached barbell and conditioning classes with programming that tracks your numbers week to week. Beginners start with three one-on-one onboarding sessions.

name: Ocean Smile Dental
summary: Family and cosmetic dentistry with early-morning appointments.
description: General, pediatric and cosmetic dentistry under one roof. Same-day crowns, clear aligners and a 7 AM chair for patients who need to be at work by nine.

name: Pinelands Family Practice
summary: Primary care for every age, with same-week sick visits.
description: Board-certified family physicians offering annual physicals, chronic-care management, school and sports forms, and sick visits within the week.

name: Monroe & Hale Law
summary: Real estate closings, wills and estate planning, small-business counsel.
description: A two-partner practice handling residential closings, wills and trusts, estate administration and entity formation for small businesses. Flat fees quoted up front where possible.

name: Coastline Realty Group
summary: Shore-town buyers, sellers and seasonal rentals.
description: A boutique brokerage covering year-round homes, second homes and summer rentals along the northern Ocean County shore.

name: Greenway Lawn & Landscape
summary: Weekly lawn care, paver patios and spring and fall cleanups.
description: Residential landscaping from weekly mowing to full hardscape builds. Design consultations include a rendered plan before any ground is broken.

name: Good Dog Grooming
summary: Calm, one-dog-at-a-time grooming. No cages, no long waits.
description: Appointment-only grooming where each dog has the groomer's full attention. Baths, breed cuts, nail trims and de-shedding treatments.

name: Main Street Mercantile
summary: Home goods, gifts and work from local makers.
description: An independent shop stocking ceramics, candles, prints and pantry goods, much of it made within fifty miles. Gift wrapping is always free.

name: Spotless Shore Cleaning
summary: Bonded, insured home and office cleaning on a schedule you set.
description: Recurring and one-time cleans, move-in and move-out service, and post-construction cleanup. The same crew every visit for recurring clients.

name: Lakeside Kitchen & Bar
summary: A neighborhood bistro with a long bar and a short, honest menu.
description: Seasonal American plates, a burger people drive for and a weekday happy hour. The back room seats up to thirty for private events.

name: Coastal Current Electric
summary: Storm-ready electrical work, from flood-zone rewiring to generators.
description: Specialists in elevating and rewiring shore homes, transfer switches, and surge protection, plus everyday repairs and fixture installs.

name: Jackson Pet Wellness
summary: Training, boarding and daycare on three fenced acres.
description: Positive-reinforcement training classes, supervised daycare play groups and overnight boarding with daily photo updates for owners.
